medium: Which 10 banks have the largest total assets, and what is each one's return on assets (ROA) and return on equity (ROE)? Are the biggest banks the most profitable?
hard: For each state, compute the total bank deposits and number of bank offices. Which states have the highest deposits-per-office, and which have the most offices per capita of deposits?
Find banks where net income (NETINC) was positive in every quarter of 2023. How many such consistently profitable banks are there, and what share of total system assets do they represent?
very_complex: Compute each bank's asset growth from Q1 2020 to Q1 2024. Which banks more than doubled their assets in that period, and what are their bank classes (BKCLASS)? Are the fastest growers concentrated in one class?

For the top 50 banks by assets, plot the trajectory of their return on assets across 2020-2024 quarters. Which bank(s) had the most volatile ROA (biggest swing between any two consecutive quarters), and which had the steadiest?
